meta.name: alterlab-rdkit
meta.description: Provides the RDKit cheminformatics toolkit for low-level, fine-grained molecular primitives — SMILES/SDF parsing, descriptors (MW, LogP, TPSA), fingerprints, substructure/SMARTS search, 2D/3D coordinate generation, similarity, and reaction handling. Use when custom sanitization, specialized fingerprint or descriptor algorithms, reaction enumeration, or conformer generation demand direct API control; for a high-level pandas-friendly wrapper over RDKit prefer alterlab-datamol, and for turning molecules into ML feature vectors prefer alterlab-molfeat. Part of the AlterLab Academic Skills suite.

copy.tagline: 用 RDKit 直接操控分子结构与化学信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要精细控制分子解析、指纹计算或反应枚举
copy.tagline_en: Control molecular structures and cheminformatics directly with RDKit
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need fine-grained control over molecular parsing, fingerprint calculation, or reaction enumeration

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能解析 SMILES/SDF 分子结构，计算分子量、LogP、TPSA 等描述符，生成指纹，进行子结构搜索，处理化学反应，生成 2D/3D 坐标，并可视化分子。
howto.when: 当你需要精细控制分子操作，如自定义校验、专用指纹或描述符算法、反应枚举、构象生成时触发。对于高级封装，建议使用 alterlab-datamol。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can parse SMILES/SDF molecular structures, compute descriptors (MW, LogP, TPSA), generate fingerprints, perform substructure searches, handle chemical reactions, generate 2D/3D coordinates, and visualize molecules.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need fine-grained molecular control, such as custom sanitization, specialized fingerprints or descriptors, reaction enumeration, or conformer generation. For high-level workflows, prefer alterlab-datamol.
